crossRefs.note: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
“Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
crossRefs.keyword: be refreshed. Heb. breathe. I will open

crossRefs.note: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
crossRefs.keyword: be refreshed. Heb. breathe. I will open

translations.web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
translations.bsb: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and respond.
translations.kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
translations.asv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.
